name: Eastercon
blurb: The UK National Science Fiction Convention, held every Easter weekend at a city chosen by yearly bid committee.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'The 78th Annual UK National Science Fiction Convention 26 —29 March 2027 Crowne Plaza Hotel, Glasgow'.

notes: The given url (eastercon.org) now redirects to a bot-walled eastercon.fandom.com wiki page, so it was replaced with the current year's official committee site, 'Unconfined' (easterconglasgow.org) for the 2027 Glasgow edition; Eastercon rotates to a new bid-committee site most years. Mark Meenan is a Fan Guest of Honour (long-time convention volunteer since 1983), not an author, hence cat 'other'. Verify-03 pass (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh re-extraction shows the Guests of Honour page's own <title> as 'Guests of Honour - Unconfined - Eastercon 2027 in Glasgow', directly naming this edition's year, with the same four guests. Refute pass (2026-10-05): upheld on stronger grounds -- the page title alone is template-level, but the guest-page images are all uploaded /2025/04/ (right when the Glasgow 'Unconfined' bid won at Eastercon 2025) and an independent dated announcement, Starburst Magazine's 'Eastercon 2026 & 2027 Announced' (published 2025-04-20), names P. Djeli Clark, L R Lam and Tamsyn Muir as Unconfined/Eastercon 2027 Glasgow's Guests of Honour specifically; critically, that same article shows the immediately-preceding edition (Iridescence, Birmingham, 3-6 April 2026) had a completely different, non-overlapping lineup (RJ Barker, Emma Newman, Karen Lord), ruling out the leftover-grid concern the image-date scan flagged. Mark Meenan's confirmation rests on the official site alone (the press piece covered only the headline author GoHs) but follows the same non-overlapping pattern.
